title: Police Blotter: 11 booked in Webb County — end-of-day roundup
excerpt: Eleven people were booked into the Webb County Jail on Nov. 24, 2026, on alleged misdemeanor charges and holds — DWI, family-violence assault, theft and more. Every arrest is an allegation; each person is presumed innocent until proven guilty.
content:
Eleven people were booked into the Webb County Jail on Tuesday, November 24, 2026, on alleged misdemeanor charges and holds, according to Webb County booking records. Each person is listed below with the charge or hold shown in their booking record. An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction, and every person named here is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Sebastian Torres Jr.

Torres was arrested by the Laredo Police Department on Tuesday, November 24, 2026, at 1:48 a.m. on a charge of theft of property valued at $750 or more but less than $2,500, a Class A misdemeanor. Bond was set at $5,000.

Luis Enrique Garay

Garay was arrested on Tuesday, November 24, 2026, at 4:00 a.m. on a charge of driving while intoxicated, a Class B misdemeanor. No bond had been set at the time of booking. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

Luis Enrique Gonzalez

Gonzalez was arrested on Tuesday, November 24, 2026, at 8:31 a.m. on charges of duty on striking an unattended vehicle, a Class B misdemeanor; duty on striking a fixture or highway landscape valued at $200 or more, a Class B misdemeanor; and driving while intoxicated with a blood alcohol concentration of 0.15 or higher, a Class A misdemeanor. Bond was set at $1,000 on each of the first two charges and $3,000 on the driving while intoxicated charge. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

William Carroll Slemaker

Slemaker was arrested on Tuesday, November 24, 2026, at 10:24 a.m. on two counts of violation of a bond or protective order, each a Class A misdemeanor. Bond was set at $10,000 on each count. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

Marlon Lisandro Rodriguez-Zuniga

Rodriguez-Zuniga was arrested on Tuesday, November 24, 2026, at 12:32 p.m. on a charge of assault causing bodily injury to a family member, a Class A misdemeanor. No bond had been set at the time of booking. He is also being held on an out-of-county/immigration hold by U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement.

Isaac Moreno

Moreno was arrested on Tuesday, November 24, 2026, at 1:20 p.m. on a charge of violation of a bond or protective order, a Class A misdemeanor. Bond was set at $0. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

Viviana Anahy Zarzosa

Zarzosa was arrested on Tuesday, November 24, 2026, at 3:44 p.m. on a charge of assault causing bodily injury, a Class A misdemeanor. Bond was set at $5,000. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

Abigail Nicole Valdez

Valdez was arrested on Tuesday, November 24, 2026, at 3:55 p.m. on two counts of assault causing bodily injury, each a Class A misdemeanor. No bond had been set on either count at the time of booking. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

Abigail Garza

Garza was arrested on Tuesday, November 24, 2026, at 4:07 p.m. on charges of assault causing bodily injury to a family member, a Class A misdemeanor, and resisting arrest, search or transport, a Class A misdemeanor. No bond had been set on either charge at the time of booking. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

Elena Gomez-de Luna

Gomez-de Luna was taken into custody by the United States Marshals on Tuesday, November 24, 2026, at 4:20 p.m. on a federal violation, a federal hold. No bond had been set at the time of booking.

Federico Galindo

Galindo was arrested on Tuesday, November 24, 2026, at 10:29 p.m. on a charge of driving while intoxicated, a Class B misdemeanor. No bond had been set at the time of booking. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.
